name: generate_video
description: Generate AI videos with xAI Grok, Google Gemini, or OpenAI Sora. Create videos from text prompts or images. Use when user says 'generate a video', 'create a video', 'make a video animation', 'animate this'. PROVIDERS: xAI Grok (default, 1-15s), OpenAI Sora (4-12s, audio), Google Gemini (Veo default: 4-8s and up to 4K; Omni Flash opt-in: 3-10s and 720p). Videos save to stash for use with other tools.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the video. Be specific about subject, action, movement, style, mood. For audio: Use quotes for dialogue like 'Hello!' and describe sounds. Example: 'A cat playing with a ball, slow motion, cinematic lighting'

provider.description: Video provider: 'xai' (default, Grok - 1-15s), 'openai' (Sora 2 - 4-12s, audio, remix), 'gemini' (Veo 3.1 by default; Omni Flash when configured). If not specified, uses VIDEO_TOOL_PROVIDER from config.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. xAI: 1-15s (any). OpenAI: rounds to 4, 8, or 12s. Gemini Veo: rounds to 4, 6, or 8s. Gemini Omni Flash: clamps to 3-10s. Default: 5 seconds.

aspect_ratio.description: Video shape. xAI supports all 7. Gemini/OpenAI only support '16:9' (widescreen) or '9:16' (vertical) - others mapped.

resolution.description: Video resolution. xAI: 720p/480p. OpenAI: 720p or 1080p (pro model). Gemini Veo: 720p-4k (1080p/4k requires 8s). Gemini Omni Flash: 720p only.

image_url.description: Image source for image-to-video. Accepts: stash reference (stash://space_xxx/file_id), local file path, or URL. For uploaded images, use the stash reference from 'Image stashed at:' in the conversation.

video_url.description: Edit an existing video's visual content/style ONLY. xAI editing CANNOT change duration, aspect ratio, or resolution — only what happens visually. If user wants different duration/size, regenerate from source image using image_url instead. xAI: MUST be a public http(s) URL, stash refs will NOT work. OpenAI: video ID to remix (starts with 'video_'). Provider URLs expire after ~4 hours.

negative_prompt.description: GEMINI ONLY: What to avoid in the video. Sent as Veo's negative prompt or appended as regular prompt guidance for Omni Flash.

save.description: Save to stash for use with other tools (default: true). Video is downloaded and stored locally.
